subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands guarantee SKILL.md injection, and if so what instruction authority and isolation boundary should that injected content have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes prompt authority for potentially untrusted skill content and must align with the broader skill security model.

options.title: Define and implement deterministic injection
options.body: Specify the trust boundary first, then implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading in the shared skill command path with focused security and prompt tests.

options.title: Keep advisory model routing
options.body: Document that ordinary skill slash commands remain model-routed unless a skill opts into `command-dispatch: tool`.

options.title: Route through broader skill tooling work
options.body: Defer this issue to a maintainer-sponsored Skill tool or router contract instead of adding a separate slash-only injection path.

recommendation.title: Define and implement deterministic injection
recommendation.body: Specify the trust boundary first, then implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading in the shared skill command path with focused security and prompt tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current user-invocable skill command surface and are the best available routing owner from the code history.
